name: Spicy Tiger 75
author: SachinKumar666
description: Rounded dark blue card that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, background-color changes from #ffffff to #fdfdfd, box-shadow becomes #000000 0px 2px 1px, #000000 0px 4px 2px,
    #000000 0px 8px 4px, #000000 0px 16px 8px,
    #000000 0px 32px 16px.
